I'll choose **Signal**.

**Why Signal stands out:**

- **Privacy by design** — Open-source, end-to-end encryption by default (Signal Protocol)
- **Non-profit** — No ads, no trackers, no data mining. Funded by donations, not beholden to shareholders
- **Minimal metadata** — Sealed Sender means Signal servers can't see who messages whom
- **Feature complete** — Texts, voice/video calls, groups, stories, payments (MobileCoin), with no utility sacrificed for privacy

**The honest trade-off:** Requires a phone number for registration (though they keep working to reduce this friction), and your contacts who don't use it won't magically appear—network effects remain the real hurdle.

- **SimpleX** — No user identifiers, dual-hop routing
- **WhatsApp/iMessage** — Where your contacts already live, though with corporate data policies attached
